structural_observation: The snapshot is a concrete persisted graph rather than only an interface specification.
All link endpoints resolve to existing node identifiers.
The graph contains 1961 isolated nodes and a high-degree central node, so raw node count should not be interpreted as semantic density.
Six self-links are present and should be reviewed by any future graph migrator.
boundaries: Node type names are producer categories and are not evidence of danger, cognition, or agency.
Graph topology does not validate semantic correctness of labels or links.
The raw state may contain personal or generated free-form text and is not committed.
